metadata.description: CLI-exclusive LLM generation ratchet. Existing API-backed generation surfaces are baselined; new files or per-file count increases fail. Gemini embeddings remain a documented API carve-out and are checked in the pytest guard.

consumer/_gemini_instructor.py.note: Deferred classifier helper: Instructor/Google GenAI structured-output support stays API-backed until the classifier migration phase.

consumer/functional_extractor.py.note: Migration target: free-form consumer extractor still calls Gemini generate_content.

consumer/llm_classifier_v2.py.note: Deferred classifier path: structured Gemini classification remains API-backed for a later phase.

consumer/thesis_filter/llm_classifier.py.note: Deferred thesis classifier: structured-output migration is intentionally out of scope for this guard-first PR.

integrations/hermes/adapters.py.note: Migration target: Hermes Kimi executor still constructs the API-backed KimiClient until the provider migration PR.

integrations/kimi_client.py.note: Migration target: Kimi/Moonshot OpenAI-compatible API client will be replaced by the shared CLI generation layer.

integrations/maestro.py.note: Migration target: Maestro still lazy-loads the API-backed KimiClient.

integrations/openai_mcp.py.note: Migration target: OpenAI API bridge still constructs AsyncOpenAI and calls chat.completions.create.

integrations/strategy_iterator.py.note: Migration target: strategy iteration still constructs OpenAIMCPServer for API-backed OpenAI perspective generation.

ops/llm_classifier_v2.py.note: Deferred classifier path: ops classification still uses Google GenAI API generation.

ops/memory/extractor.py.note: Migration target: memory extractor still calls Gemini generate_content.

profilers/extractors/llm_extractor.py.note: Migration target: profiler LLM extractor still calls Gemini generate_content.

utils/news_digest.py.note: Migration target: news digest helper still calls Gemini generate_content; embedding APIs remain the permanent carve-out.
